prompt_en: One continuous photographic art-performance portrait: an adult art performer conducts a still appearance-and-surface inspection in a glass-roof botanical workroom. She is a fictional 27-year-old woman. Reference guidance comes from the supplied face and hair appearance. Her short dark bob has fine separated bangs, and her calm direct gaze acknowledges the camera. Her head and torso face forward on the same plane; her arms rest loosely beside her body as she stands upright. Each transparent theatrical contact lens bears one tiny opaque crimson heart centered over the visible black pupil region; each surrounding brown iris, sclera and eyelid retains its ordinary eye structure. The artificial lens prints are clearly resolved in both open eyes. A deep-blue abstract pigment marking sits on her own bare lower abdominal skin, its center four centimeters directly below her visible navel, with its entire six-centimeter width above the trouser waistband. On this frontal skin plane, the navel-to-central-diamond-center distance equals two-thirds of the marking's full horizontal width; a visible band of bare skin separates the lower stem from the trouser waistband. The pigment follows the shallow curved skin surface and preserves visible pores and a gentle sideward falloff. This deliberately chosen marking has four disconnected elements: one closed central diamond, two mirrored open C-curves facing the diamond, and one short vertical stem below it. A boxy ivory sleeveless utility top ends above the navel; slate canvas work trousers sit below the marking. The scene records the freshly applied pigment settling. Beside her, a shallow tray on the plant bench holds the matching four cut-paper shapes and a capped blue paint bottle; a small brass plate catches a narrow amber reflection. Diffuse overcast skylight softly separates her from ribbed glass, leaves and worn timber. The crown-to-upper-hips composition gives equal reading space to her face and lower-abdominal marking, with both eyes and skin pigment sharply legible at native resolution. Fine photographic skin texture, neutral color and restrained workshop detail keep this a quiet material experiment.

authorial_decisions.decision: Clarify the existing four-centimeter center distance and six-centimeter marking width as a visible two-thirds relative spacing relation, while retaining the same skin, topology and wardrobe-boundary relation.
authorial_decisions.rationale: Attempt 1 shows an observable navel-to-center/full-width ratio far smaller than the independently frozen 4/6 relation. This is a local layout clarification rather than a new motif, carrier, crop or meaning.

semantic_clarification_decisions.rationale: Retain every frozen requester-owned anchor while keeping the independently authored test geometry unchanged.

The frozen direct inspection uses ordinarily open eyes and a calm closed-lip face; upward/asymmetric pupils with exposed tongue would change the independent test rather than clarify its artificial heart lens print.
This is a physically ordinary pigment and lens experiment; a broken world invariant would introduce unrelated impossible behavior.
The photograph contains no trusted counterpart, target-directed assistance or same-target helpful consequence; appearance cannot supply that relationship.
Glass belongs to the workshop background. A pane between camera and performer plus overlaid reflection would risk obscuring the two target regions.
The frontal continuous view is direct. A mirror-led face and corresponding partial body view would add an unrelated reflected carrier.
The arms rest by the performer sides and the props are transfer materials; a handheld mirror and reflected face would add a different interaction.
The face and utility top are already present, but the focal surface is skin rather than garment detail. This general portrait condition adds no target lens/marking contribution.
The declared artificial lens print is a coherent art material. A localized realism contradiction intended to produce unease would introduce another test meaning.

decisions.rationale: Retain the frontal face-and-skin hierarchy because fine pupil detail needs the existing centered frontal inspection.
A hand-supported mirror would introduce reflected-face geometry outside the chosen direct inspection.
A scanned access card supplies an unrelated duty event rather than pigment transfer.
The face reference and open-eyes observation do not justify reshaping the eye contour into a catlike ideal.
The baseline already uses diffuse overcast skylight and brass reflection. Retain that independent light without claiming this optional candidate added it.

review.summary: Rechecked the entire targeted retry. Only the existing below-navel spacing is given a dimensionless equivalent of 4/6; all four disconnected elements, both pupil-region motifs, same performer skin, same body plane, top/trouser boundaries and the same crown-to-upper-hips framing remain. The stem still clears the waistband. No new gesture, support state or reference claim is introduced.
